name: zinc-dark
source: derived from zinc-light (beautiful-mermaid lineage, MIT) — ground moved to zinc-800 #27272A, ink to zinc-200 #E4E4E7, borders to zinc-600 #52525B; lineColor held at #939394 because it clears contrast on both grounds. borders zinc-600 #52525B -> #78787f (1.93 -> 3.40 on the node fill) to hold the 3:1 floor in scripts/tests/test_theme_contrast.py. Tableau 10 categorical palette, lightness tuned so near-black labels hold 4.5:1 on every fill, for cScale/pie/git/xyChart; full xyChart object; themeCSS for the timeline axis and packet blocks, which no themeVariable can reach. Kanban headers (cScale +/-10% lightness) and treemap leaves (0.3 over 0.6 opacity) drew labels under 4.5:1, so themeCSS pins exact section colours and full treemap opacity. Kanban header text is `.cluster-label{color:textColor}`, so themeCSS gives section headers the label colour (scoped to section groups: flowchart subgraph labels share the class); treemap leaves get a ground-coloured stroke so opaque leaves stay separate. Hard-coded colours: C4 draws relationships in #444444 attributes (1.92:1 here), so attribute-selector rules repaint lines and arrowheads lineColor and labels textColor; sankey links carry an inline multiply blend that turns them near-black on this ground, so .link gets mix-blend-mode:normal !important; d3 strokes gantt grid lines currentColor (black), so .grid .tick line gets a quiet grey. C4 boxes: every C4 box draws #FFFFFF text, and five of mermaid's default fills (external system #999999, container #438DD5, external container #B3B3B3, component #85BBF0, external component #CCCCCC) hold it at only 2.0 to 3.6:1, so themeCSS gives those boxes #18181B text (5.1:1 or more) and keeps the C4 fills; the selector uses :has(), so a renderer without it falls back to white.
themeCSS: .lineWrapper line{stroke:#939394;} .packetBlock{fill:#2E2E31;stroke:#78787f;} .packetByte.start,.packetByte.end{fill:#A1A1AA;} .treemapLeaf,.treemapSection{fill-opacity:1;} .treemapLeaf{stroke:#27272A;} .section--1 rect,.section--1 polygon{fill:#5B86B3;stroke:#5B86B3;} .section-0 rect,.section-0 polygon{fill:#F28E2B;stroke:#F28E2B;} .section-1 rect,.section-1 polygon{fill:#E15759;stroke:#E15759;} .section-2 rect,.section-2 polygon{fill:#76B7B2;stroke:#76B7B2;} .section-3 rect,.section-3 polygon{fill:#59A14F;stroke:#59A14F;} .section-4 rect,.section-4 polygon{fill:#EDC948;stroke:#EDC948;} .section-5 rect,.section-5 polygon{fill:#B07AA1;stroke:#B07AA1;} .section-6 rect,.section-6 polygon{fill:#A07A64;stroke:#A07A64;} .section-7 rect,.section-7 polygon{fill:#5B86B3;stroke:#5B86B3;} .section-8 rect,.section-8 polygon{fill:#F28E2B;stroke:#F28E2B;} .section-9 rect,.section-9 polygon{fill:#E15759;stroke:#E15759;} .section-10 rect,.section-10 polygon{fill:#76B7B2;stroke:#76B7B2;} [class*=section-] .cluster-label{color:#18181B;} .link{mix-blend-mode:normal !important;} [stroke="#444444"]{stroke:#939394;} [fill="#444444"]{fill:#939394;} text[fill="#444444"]{fill:#E4E4E7;} .grid .tick line{stroke:#52525B;} .person-man:has([fill="#999999"]) text,.person-man:has([fill="#438DD5"]) text,.person-man:has([fill="#B3B3B3"]) text,.person-man:has([fill="#85BBF0"]) text,.person-man:has([fill="#CCCCCC"]) text{fill:#18181B;}
